commands.observation: aso-host, aso-server-axum, and aso-web-server dev profiles finished after the authorization repair

discarded.reason: ran 0 tests; not counted as evidence
tee masked the initial formatting failure; the line was formatted and the command was rerun with pipefail before counting it as Passed.
ran 0 tests because the Rust test name was not module-qualified; not counted as evidence

database_probes.observation: Fresh install passed actual AppServices/PostgreSQL resolution lifecycle with five states, member-plan enrollment, versioned path receipts, four authoritative invalidations, three-way validity intersection, restricted executor, durable receipts and audits, command lookup, tenant refusal, SQLSTATE 42501 retry refusal, and cleanup. Re-resolution after entity deactivation returned missing rather than expired.

Populated upgrade preserved cases and affirmations, repaired legacy summaries, refused checksum mismatch without data loss, and passed the same authoritative lifecycle, source-version invalidation, enrollment-bounded validity, invalidation, receipt provenance, and SQLSTATE 42501 retry checks. Re-resolution after entity deactivation returned missing rather than expired.

review_repairs.finding: Resolver-only callers were incorrectly routed through case_write target authorization.
review_repairs.red_observation: Failed with HTTP 403 where resolver-only authorization required 204; exit 101.
review_repairs.repair: Added resolver-specific AppServices and CaseRepository target authorization, backed by aso.authorize_administering_entity_target(target_case), which requires resolve_administering_entity instead of case_write. Resolution POST and command lookup use this path.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The same mounted test passed 1/1 and retained the no-mutation assertion. Fresh and populated-upgrade PostgreSQL probes passed through the restricted executor.

review_repairs.finding: An unresolved case's GET resolution gate used read_administering_entity and returned 404 before the route could represent the unresolved state.
review_repairs.red_observation: The mounted unresolved-read assertion failed with HTTP 404 where gate forwarding required 204; exit 101.
review_repairs.repair: The read branch now authorizes the underlying case with AppServices::read_case; the resolution route remains responsible for representing missing resolution state.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The same mounted test passed 1/1 and confirmed gate authorization performed no repository write.

review_repairs.finding: A successful resolution command lost its durable command ID when the post-commit reload failed.
review_repairs.red_observation: The hook published error with a null pendingCommandId after a successful receipt and failed reload; 1 of 3 tests failed.
review_repairs.repair: The post-commit reload has its own failure path that publishes uncertain and retains receipt.value.commandId for exact lookup reconciliation.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The hook test passed 3/3; the full five-file focused browser set passed 20/20.

review_repairs.finding: An idempotent SQL retry returned its stored receipt before reauthorizing the target case.
review_repairs.red_observation: With the old ordering temporarily restored, the target case was moved out of scope inside a rollback-only synthetic transaction and the command returned successfully; the required 42501 check failed.
review_repairs.repair: aso.resolve_administering_entity_command now calls aso.require_case(target_case, 'resolve_administering_entity') before reading or returning an existing command receipt.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade PostgreSQL probes both passed; the same out-of-scope retry was refused with SQLSTATE 42501, and fixture cleanup passed.

review_repairs.finding: The resolver treated member_id as presence-only and did not verify authoritative plan enrollment.
review_repairs.red_command: Temporarily removed the three member/enrollment predicates, then ran the disposable PostgreSQL service lifecycle.
review_repairs.red_observation: The changed-member case incorrectly resolved; the lifecycle failed because Resolved was returned where Missing was required.
review_repairs.repair: Added effective-dated payer_plan_enrollments and joined member, plan, practice, and service-date validity into current and historical candidate evaluation.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade probes return Missing for an unenrolled member and pass the complete lifecycle.

review_repairs.finding: Changes to an entity, plan, enrollment, or delegation rule could leave a stale resolved row usable.
review_repairs.red_command: Temporarily disabled entity resolution invalidation and ran the rollback-only authoritative-change probe.
review_repairs.red_observation: Entity deactivation did not remove the current resolution; return codes were [3, 0, 0].
review_repairs.repair: Added targeted invalidation triggers that advance resolution_revision and delete affected current resolutions for entity, plan, enrollment, and rule mutations.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade probes pass entity deactivation, appeal-path edit, and conflicting-rule insertion with return codes [0, 0, 0].

review_repairs.finding: A transport-uncertain command ID was scoped to one mounted view and could not be reconciled after remount.
review_repairs.red_command: Temporarily removed pre-dispatch retention and ran the hook remount test.
review_repairs.red_observation: The remounted hook had a null pendingCommandId and could not perform exact lookup.
review_repairs.repair: Added a session/practice/authorization-revision/epoch/case-scoped vanilla Zustand store backed by tab sessionStorage, retained before dispatch and cleared only on terminal reconciliation.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The remount regression passes; the focused browser set passes 21/21.

review_repairs.finding: Durable history did not identify the exact authoritative path versions used for a committed result.
review_repairs.repair: Added monotonic revisions to resolver inputs and stored entity, path, validity, source, and entity/plan/enrollment/rule/source-document versions in immutable command receipts and audits.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Mounted HTTP requires the complete receipt allowlist; disposable PostgreSQL lifecycle requires revision 1 for all authoritative inputs and source document version 1.

review_repairs.finding: The versioned receipt initially failed under the restricted executor because its security-definer owner could not read document_version.
review_repairs.red_observation: Actual lifecycle failed with SQLSTATE 42501 permission denied for table documents; cleanup passed.
review_repairs.repair: Granted only id and document_version SELECT to the non-login aso_case_owner role and added its trusted owner policy; aso_case_executor retains execute-only access.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade probes pass, while direct executor writes remain refused.

review_repairs.finding: A remount could accept an older committed row before reconciling an uncertain re-resolution.
review_repairs.repair: Load performs exact command lookup before reading current resolution whenever a scoped pending command exists.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Focused hook tests cover committed and absent uncertain outcomes with lookup ordered before current-state read; 6/6 hook tests pass.

review_repairs.finding: Selected source changes could leave a stale current resolution.
review_repairs.repair: Document content/version changes invalidate resolutions whose selected rule or effective enrollment uses that source.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade probes pass source_document_version invalidation; all four invalidation return codes are zero.

review_repairs.finding: Resolved validity omitted the member-enrollment interval.
review_repairs.repair: Validity is the intersection of plan, enrollment, and delegation-rule windows.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The synthetic valid enrollment is narrower and both AppServices/PostgreSQL probes assert 2026-02-01 through 2026-12-31.

review_repairs.finding: The panel displayed only a source UUID.
review_repairs.repair: Resolution reads and receipts carry source name, effective date, and version, and the panel renders those fields.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Focused component tests and mounted receipt checks pass with human-readable source metadata.

review_repairs.finding: The first exact-command lookup 404 could race the still-running original command transaction and make an older committed row appear final.
review_repairs.repair: The pending store retains command ID plus expected case-input revision. Recovery reissues the same command idempotently after lookup 404 and reads current state only after the durable receipt returns.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The focused hook test orders exact lookup before same-ID resolve retry before current-state read; the five-file browser set passes 23/23.

review_repairs.finding: A case-detail read failed before POST dispatch but the generated command was already persisted and could become unrecoverably uncertain.
review_repairs.repair: The hook now loads the case revision first and persists command ID plus retry payload only immediately before POST dispatch.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The pre-dispatch 5xx regression leaves no pending command, performs no resolve POST or lookup, and a remounted view can issue a fresh successful command.

review_repairs.finding: Lookup 404 followed by a same-ID stale_revision retry conclusively proved absence but left the view permanently uncertain.
review_repairs.repair: Terminal pending-command errors clear the stored command and reload current state; the ordinary resolve action is then available for a new command ID and revision.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The regression reaches unresolved with no pending ID, then commits a fresh command at case-input revision 4; the hook suite passes 8/8.

review_repairs.finding: A currently effective delegation rule pointing to an inactive entity was reported as expired.
review_repairs.repair: The SQL resolver separately counts current inactive-entity matches and returns missing; UI copy names the absence of an active matching path.
review_repairs.restored_observation: Fresh and populated-upgrade PostgreSQL probes re-resolve after deactivation as missing, and the component test rejects expired copy.

review_repairs.finding: Lookup 404 followed by a serialized case_inputs_incomplete retry conclusively proved absence but left the view permanently uncertain.
review_repairs.repair: case_inputs_incomplete is now a terminal pending-command result alongside stale_revision; the hook clears the command, reloads committed state, and retains the specific missing-input guidance.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The focused regression reaches unresolved with no pending ID and the exact missing-input message; the hook suite passes 9/9 and the five-file set passes 27/27.

review_repairs.finding: The visible Check saved command path cleared case_inputs_incomplete but dropped the specific guidance after reloading current state.
review_repairs.repair: After terminal manual reconciliation, the hook reapplies the terminal guidance only when reload ends in ready or unresolved, preserving any independent reload error.
review_repairs.restored_observation: The direct reconcile regression ends unresolved with no pending ID and the exact missing-input guidance; the hook suite passes 10/10 and the five-file set passes 28/28.

claim_boundary: Focused T0/T1 only. Web-17 owns local Tier 2 actual-browser case-to-letter certification; Tauri and mobile remain deferred.
